title: 70. How can I change my survey's contact information?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How can I change my survey's contact information.
short_answer: Open the survey and go to the 'Properties' page. You can choose between the following 'Contact' options under 'Basic' settings:
procedure: Contact Form: This allows users to contact you using a form. E-mail: This allows users to contact you directly by email (your email will be disclosed). Web-page: This directs users to a specific webpage.
If you have already published your survey, go to the 'Overview' page and click 'Apply Changes'.
